svg.aria-label: A test bench that follows one command from thumb to tail. On the left a transmitter gimbal with its stick in a slot over a scale. In the middle a receiver on a foam pad with its two antennas and a lead to a standard servo, which lies on its side between two mounting posts. Its arm drives a 105 millimetre pushrod to a control horn under the elevator of a clamped tail section. A ruler post beside the trailing edge reads the throw. Full stick moves the elevator about 20 degrees.
